description: This file contains UI test cases for the OnboardingView component, including setup, various page order configurations, and remote gateway selection logic within the OnboardingViewSmokeTests suite.

classes.name: OnboardingViewSmokeTests
classes.description: A test suite struct for smoke testing the OnboardingView UI component, including multiple test methods for different onboarding scenarios.

methods.name: onboarding view builds body

methods.name: page order omits onboarding chat when identity known
